name: Giant Bat
otherStatistics: Initiative +3 (13). Proficiency bonus +2. Blindsight 120 ft. Passive Perception 11. Languages none.
appearance: A large brown bat with a furry body, pointed ears and wide leathery wings.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 355. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195012-giant-bat
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack roll +5, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

name: Giant Boar
otherStatistics: Initiative +0 (10). Proficiency bonus +2. Passive Perception 8. Languages none.
appearance: An oversized dark bristled boar with a high ridge of coarse hair, stout legs and long ivory tusks.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 355. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195013-giant-boar
sections.Traits: Bloodied Fury. The boar has advantage on melee attack rolls when Bloodied, at half its HP or fewer.
sections.Actions: Gore. Melee attack roll +5, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the boar moved at least 20 ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit, it takes another 7 (2d6) piercing damage and falls Prone.

name: Giant Centipede
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency bonus +2. Blindsight 30 ft. Passive Perception 8. Languages none.
appearance: A segmented rusty-brown centipede with gold legs, long antennae and prominent forcipules.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 355. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195014-giant-centipede
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee attack roll +4, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage and inflict Poisoned until the start of the centipede’s next turn.

name: Giant Constrictor Snake
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency bonus +2. Perception +2. Blindsight 10 ft. Passive Perception 12. Languages none.
appearance: A heavy coiled snake with a broad head and irregular amber and dark olive blotches.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 355. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195015-giant-constrictor-snake
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite attack and use Constrict.
Bite. Melee attack roll +6, reach 10 ft. On a hit, deal 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.
Constrict. One visible Large or smaller creature within 10 ft. makes a DC 14 Strength save. On a failure, it takes 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage and is Grappled, escape DC 14.

name: Giant Crab
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency bonus +2. Stealth +3. Blindsight 30 ft. Passive Perception 9. Languages none.
appearance: A broad russet-and-slate crab with stalked eyes, eight jointed walking legs and two heavy pincers.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, revised Monster Manual (2025 release, 2024 rules), p. 356. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775818-giant-crab
sections.Traits: Amphibious. The crab can breathe air and water.
sections.Actions: Claw. Melee attack roll +3, reach 5 ft. On a hit, deal 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit by the claw is Grappled by one of the crab’s two claws, escape DC 11.
